# MCP specification fixtures

Copied unchanged from
[modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/modelcontextprotocol)
(`schema/2026-07-28/schema.json`, `schema/2025-11-25/schema.json`, and four
examples from `schema/2026-07-28/examples/`), fetched 2026-10-22. That project
is licensed Apache-2.0 (older contributions MIT); see its LICENSE.

`tests/mcp-protocol.test.js` validates the server's responses against these
schemas and replays the examples. Refresh them when a new protocol revision is
supported.
